scope: Visual treatment across the existing 42 circuit layouts; scenery placement and many details are artistic approximations, not scanned official-game assets.

references.feature: Paul Ricard Blue Line red/blue runoff
Circuit surface, kerbs and safety fencing context
Albert Park lake, city views and parkland context
Jones grandstand at Turn 1; reference rather than exact event placement
Shanghai circuit architecture, main grandstand and pit complex
Shanghai circuit setting, long back straight and stadium corner context
Shanghai photo-reference main stand roof and bridge placement
Shanghai H/K grandstand footprint and cream canopy placement
Shanghai lotus-leaf side stands and lantern-inspired main architecture

assets: Original procedural textures and geometry; existing OpenStreetMap footprint credits retained.
albertPark: Mapped lake and islands; approximate Melbourne skyline silhouettes and event dressing, with golden-hour lighting per the user brief. Tree species are represented by generic broadleaf and palm artwork.
shanghai: Corrected using the two user-supplied photographs and mapped roof/building outlines: cream funnel canopies at H/K, enclosed viewing bridges over the main straight, and pit/main-stand sides aligned with the map. Procedural cladding, crowds, windows and branding remain approximations; original track and rain effects are unchanged.
